title: ShoppingListCardView
description: Add `CookbookApp/ShoppingLists/ShoppingListCardView.swift` — the card row rendered in the list-of-lists view. Displays: a leading `cart.fill` SF Symbol on a `.tint`-tinted rounded square (matching the recipes-list thumbnail fallback pattern); title in `.headline`; a relative-time modification date string (via `ShoppingListFiles`'s shared `RelativeDateTimeFormatter`); a subtitle row showing total item count with `list.bullet` and done-item count with `checkmark.circle.fill`; a trailing `chevron.right`. All icon-only controls carry accessibility labels.
acceptance_criteria: Leading icon is `cart.fill` on a `.tint`-coloured square background
Relative-time string is derived from the file's contentModificationDate
Item count uses `list.bullet` icon; done count uses `checkmark.circle.fill` icon
Accessibility labels set on all non-text icon elements
Compiles without errors and renders correctly in a SwiftUI Preview
